title: Japan's Nikkei rises on sharp Advantest gains
description: Japan's Nikkei share average saw gains on Thursday, boosted by Advantest.  Advantest's shares surged after it raised its annual profit forecast significantly.  Other chip-related stocks also experienced upward movement following this positive outlook.  However, the broader Topix index declined as banking shares faced selling pressure.  This divergence reflects a recent market trend favoring AI-related stocks over value shares.

title: Gold edges higher as markets weigh Warsh's inflation message after Fed decision
description: Gold prices saw a slight increase as markets evaluated Federal Reserve comments. The central bank maintained interest rates, leaving future policy moves uncertain. Investors now anticipate a lower probability of a September rate hike. Other precious metals also experienced gains amid these developments. Geopolitical events in the Middle East are also contributing to market caution.

title: Dollar steadies as Fed holds rates, US strikes Iran
description: The US dollar strengthened in Asian trading after the Federal Reserve maintained its interest rate. Geopolitical developments, including air strikes in Iran, also supported the greenback's value. Other currencies like the British pound and euro experienced slight declines against the dollar. Treasury bond yields saw a significant increase following the Federal Reserve's policy decision. Bitcoin and ether prices showed modest gains in the cryptocurrency market.

title: Oil prices slip as tankers continue to ply Middle East conflict zones
description: Oil prices saw a decline as tankers continued to move out of the Middle East.  Escalating tensions and expanded conflict fronts are impacting regional stability.  Thirty-nine commodity ships passed through the Bab el-Mandeb strait into the Red Sea.  Iran has ruled out an Omani proposal for regional joint management of the strait.  Saudi Arabia is seeking to build a coalition to protect Red Sea shipping from Houthi attacks.

title: Adani Ports Q1 net profit rises 10% on overseas growth
description: Adani Ports reported a 10.2% profit increase for the June quarter. Higher cargo volumes and international port business fueled this significant growth. Revenue from operations climbed 18.6 percent to ₹10,820.80 crore. The company's international ports business saw revenue surge eighty percent. Domestic ports revenue grew twelve percent as cargo volumes increased.

title: Adani Enterprises posts Q1 loss on US govt charge
description: Adani Enterprises reported a net loss of ₹1,160 crore for the June quarter. This loss was due to an exceptional charge related to an OFAC settlement. Strong growth in airports and roads businesses boosted operating performance significantly. The company reaffirmed its capital expenditure plans for upcoming fiscal years. Adani Enterprises has no current plans to enter the airline business.
